# Flutter Testing

Use the matching detailed skill before writing tests:

- Widget tests: `.github/skills/flutter-add-widget-test/SKILL.md`
- Integration tests: `.github/skills/flutter-add-integration-test/SKILL.md`
- Widget previews: `.github/skills/flutter-add-widget-preview/SKILL.md`

Keep tests focused on behavior that can fail: rendered state, user interactions, navigation effects, validation messages, and repository/ViewModel state transitions.
